# Mass Defect and Binding Energy

**Mass defect** $\Delta m$: the difference between the mass of the separated nucleons and the actual mass of the nucleus:
$$\Delta m = Zm_p + Nm_n - m_{nucleus}$$

**Binding energy** (Einstein's mass-energy equivalence):
$$E = \Delta m \cdot c^2$$
where $c = 3 \times 10^8$ m s⁻¹

**Nuclear Fission Example:**
$${}^{235}_{92}\text{U} + {}^1_0\text{n} \rightarrow {}^{141}_{56}\text{Ba} + {}^{92}_{36}\text{Kr} + 3{}^1_0\text{n} + \text{energy}$$

- Energy released ≈ 200 MeV per fission event
